description: This file defines the OAuthServer class for managing OAuth 2.0 authorization flows within the OrangeHRM system. It initializes and configures an OAuth2 server with relevant repositories, grant types, and TTL configurations, and provides accessor methods for these TTL settings.

classes.name: OAuthServer
classes.description: Class responsible for initializing and providing access to the OAuth2 AuthorizationServer instance, configuring grant types, and TTL settings.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the OAuth server configuration, repositories, keys, and TTLs.

methods.name: getServer
methods.description: Returns the configured AuthorizationServer instance, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: getAuthCodeTTL
methods.description: Returns the TTL duration for authorization codes.

methods.name: getRefreshTokenTTL
methods.description: Returns the TTL duration for refresh tokens.

methods.name: getAccessTokenTTL
methods.description: Returns the TTL duration for access tokens.
